build_model_server: build a fastapi model server that wraps llm builtins and exposes tokenize, generate_text, and count_tokens as API endpoints
run_generate_text: run the model server generate_text endpoint to generate text from a prompt with optional temperature and max_tokens
run_tokenize: run the model server tokenize endpoint to convert text content into a list of token ids
run_count_tokens: run the model server count_tokens endpoint to count the number of tokens in a text string
test_health_check: test the model server health check endpoint to verify the server is running
